# Housing365 India - LLM Context File
> India's unified property platform for leasing, verification, property care, management, buy & sell. 100% verified owners, ₹0 standard owner listing fee, legal e-stamped agreements, and end-to-end property solutions across all Indian cities.

## About Housing365 India
Housing365 India is an enterprise-grade unified property platform operating across India's top metropolitan and tier-1/tier-2 urban markets including Bengaluru, Mumbai, Delhi NCR (Gurugram, Noida, Delhi, Faridabad, Ghaziabad), Pune, Hyderabad, Chennai, and Kolkata. Founded to bring radical transparency and institutional leasing efficiency to Indian real estate, Housing365 India provides direct owner-tenant connections, zero brokerage for tenants, 100% Aadhaar-verified owners, e-stamped legal rental agreements, biometric police verification, and complete property care.

## Core Pillars & Services
- **Marketplace & Discovery** - 100% verified flats, independent houses, villas, and commercial properties. Zero brokerage for direct tenants and ₹0 standard owner listing fee.
- **Tenant Verification & Screening** - Comprehensive Aadhaar ID verification, employer verification, CIBIL/Experian credit checks, and local biometric police background verification.
- **Legal Rent Agreements** - Legally vetted, state-specific e-stamped rental agreements compliant with the Model Tenancy Act, signed digitally via Aadhaar e-Sign.
- **Property Care & Maintenance** - Deep cleaning, painting, plumbing, electrical maintenance, pest control, and periodic physical property inspections.
- **NRI Property Management** - Dedicated relationship managers, keys custody, scheduled tenant visits, rent collection, and property condition audits for overseas Indian landlords.
- **Institutional & Society Lease-Up** - Multi-unit leasing solutions for gated communities, builders, and developers.

## Why Housing365 India
- ₹0 Standard Owner Listing Fee - Zero upfront cost to list on India's verified network.
- Zero Brokerage for Tenants - Direct connections with genuine property owners.
- 100% Verified Owners & Clean Title Verification - Elimination of duplicate or ghost listings.
- Fast Turnaround - Average 14-day placement across major metro markets.
- Legally Enforceable - State-specific stamp duty and digital e-stamping.
- Dedicated Care Desk - On-demand home maintenance and emergency repairs.

## Pricing & Monetization
- **Standard Owner Listing:** ₹0 (Free forever, verified owner badge, multi-portal syndication).
- **Contact Access Packs:** Flexible credit packages (Micro, Standard, Enterprise) for direct owner inquiries and verified buyer/tenant contact unlocks.
- **Legal Rental Agreement:** ₹499 - ₹1,499 (State stamp duty, digital stamping, and Aadhaar e-sign).
- **Property Care:** Itemized transparent quotes with verified professional vendors.
